scope: Focused source checks execute the actual current Towers render/reconciliation functions, mode guards, native Back routing, lifecycle, command/research queues and selection/build/module paths under deterministic transport/API stubs. These are source checks, not emulator or gameplay proof. The unrelated placement-preview harness reported failing against unchanged0.10 is not counted as passing evidence. Frozen program/data/map/policy bytes and complete native provenance are verified separately by package-verification.
